hypothesis: AuroraPIC using the paper's published analytic argon cross-section fits at 293 K reproduces its Table 8 fixed-swarm drift velocity and mean energy at 50 and 100 Td within 10%, after independently required stationarity and precision gates pass.

aligned: published analytic elastic, aggregate excitation, and ionization cross-section fits
isotropic elastic scattering and fixed computational population
not_fully_specified_by_source: published Monte Carlo timestep and convergence tolerances
model_alignment.aurorapic_assumption: equal-energy isotropic ionization with the generated secondary discarded in fixed_population_no_avalanche mode

classification: Passing all gates is an external published-simulation reproduction milestone for homogeneous argon transport. It is stronger than internal convergence but remains one model-level comparison, not experimental validation or validation of self-consistent PIC fields, boundaries, or device observables.
claim_boundary: Failure is diagnostic until the source's under-specified ionization and population treatment is resolved. Cross sections must not be tuned to force agreement.
